svg.title: RADIUS: a 20-byte header, then attributes
svg.desc: The Access-Request of frame 1 of radius.pcap, 32 bits per row: code 1, identifier 5, length 139, the 16-byte request authenticator, then the attributes as type-length-value triplets, NAS-IP-Address 10.0.0.1, NAS-Port 50012, NAS-Port-Type 15 and User-Name John.McGuirk shown, six more summarised; RadiusPacket keeps the header fields and the list of RadiusAttribute, each with its raw type, its named kind, its length and its value bytes.
